# Kittyark的站点

> KittyArk 的个人博客——视觉小说汉化与剧情解析。

This is the llms.txt file for Kittyark的站点. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://kittyark.github.io/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://kittyark.github.io/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://kittyark.github.io/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.
